newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PAL selects arrangers for Airbus financing.
newsitem.headline: PAL selects arrangers for Airbus financing.

text.p: Philippine Airlines Inc said on Thursday it had selected several institutions to raise and arrange finance of $985 million for the purchase of 13 aircraft from Airbus Industrie.

The airline said it will tap two consortiums for the purchase of four A340-300 and five A330-300 aircraft. These are the consortium of Banque Indosuez, Indosuez AirFinance Asia Co Ltd, the Development Bank of Singapore and Kredietbank ; and the group of Bayerische Landesbank and Kreditanstalt fur Wiederaufbau.
Indosuez AirFinance Asia will act as the overall arranger for the transaction for four A340-300 and five A330-300 aircraft.
It also selected Marubeni Corp to underwrite the financing of three A320-200 and Kreditanstalt for one A320-200.
Financing will be structured in the form of finance leases funded by commercial facilities of up to 15-year payment period, the statement said.
The airline said it had received 11 offers amounting to more than $5 billion in commitments when it sent out invitations to financial institutions on the financing for the Airbus project.
Credit Lyonnaise is acting as financial advisor to Philippine Airlines for the project, the statement said.
The airline plans to buy a total of 36 aircraft worth $3.2 billion which may be completed in 1998 or 1999.
